name: mail
description: Read non-Google mail through an account configured in GNOME Online Accounts.

interface.longDescription: Search and read Microsoft, Microsoft 365, Exchange, and compatible IMAP mail locally through GNOME Online Accounts. Cusco stores only the selected account ID, never its password or access token.
